analogy.rationale: SLC8A1 (NCX) and TRPC3/5/6 are ion channels/transporters that are poorly expressed or functionally silent in most of these cancer cell lines, so NCX inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional response; other ion-channel blockers are the closest reference classes but also act on largely non-expressed targets, giving weak similarity.
